rules.name: nonzero
rules.why: paying in must always mint something

rules.name: deposit_assets
rules.why: a deposit raises assets by exactly the amount

rules.name: deposit_supply
rules.why: the shares minted are exactly the shares reported

rules.name: donate_assets
rules.why: a donation raises assets by exactly the amount

rules.name: fair_mint
rules.expr: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret) * pre("totalAssets") > wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")
rules.why: a depositor never gets more shares than their fair fraction

rules.name: first_mint
rules.expr: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") == 0 and ret != arg(0)

rules.name: typo_rule
rules.why: deliberately bad: there is no withdraw function (tests the vacuity check)

rules.name: bad_rule
rules.expr: called("donate") and ok and post("totalAssets") == pre("totalAssets")
rules.why: deliberately wrong: donating 0 is allowed (tests the honest-usage check)
